==================
Binary operator overload
==================

Class Vector
    Public Shared Operator +(a As Vector, b As Vector) As Vector
        Return New Vector()
    End Operator
End Class

==================
Unary operator overload
==================

Class Counter
    Public Shared Operator Not(c As Counter) As Counter
        Return New Counter()
    End Operator
End Class

==================
Comparison operator overload
==================

Class Money
    Public Shared Operator =(a As Money, b As Money) As Boolean
        Return True
    End Operator

    Public Shared Operator <>(a As Money, b As Money) As Boolean
        Return False
    End Operator
End Class

==================
CType conversion operator
==================

Class Temperature
    Public Shared Widening Operator CType(t As Temperature) As Double
        Return 0.0
    End Operator

    Public Shared Narrowing Operator CType(d As Double) As Temperature
        Return New Temperature()
    End Operator
End Class
